main_text.p: ponitur, Νομοθεσία, seu solennis illa legis diuinæ promulgatio & repetitio facta in monte Sina, multis milibus hominum audientibus & spectantibus. Exod. 19. & 20.

Sic autem ratiocinatur: Quis homo intelligens dubitet, eum populum, Dei opus, & quidem κατ' ἐξοχὴν uocare, cui ne deesset ueri cultus Dei & officiorum certissima regula, Legem suam Dominus Deus publice & ingentibus cum miraculis & prodigijs dignatus est promulgare & inculcare?
Atqui in gratia populi Israelitici istud præstitit Iehouah.
Quare certum est, hunc populum recte dici Opus Dei.
main_text.head: Quæ tibi in hoc argumento obseruanda uidentur?
main_text.p: Circumstantiæ promulgatæ Legis in monte Sina, de quibus ordine & breuiter hæc annotare libet.

1. Νομοθέτης fuit Iehouah, qui hoc loco uocatur Elohah & Sanctus. Tribuitur autem ei, qui σοφωδῶς ubique est, aduentus κατ' ἀνθρωποπάθειαν: eo quòd in illa Legis promulgatione præsentiam suā illustribus testimonijs fecit, testatam.

page.notes: Greek words are transcribed as legible; several Greek accents and breathings in the scan are faint, so the exact diacritics of the Greek words (σοφωδῶς, κατ' ἀνθρωποπάθειαν, κατ' ἐξοχὴν) are doubtful and marked only in this note. The Greek on the 1st line of the second paragraph is in the original and unclear. The reading "2. For" at the foot is cut off by the page edge and may continue on the next page. The printed "2." and "Fo" are partially hidden. The word "obseruanda" is printed with that spelling.
